relationship: Executable reconstruction of the G16 direction recorded by completed G15. It is not an exact continuation of G15 because G15 checkpoint bytes were verified locally but were not published remotely; this screen starts both arms from identical fresh initialization and uses newly generated data.

hypotheses.H16a: Least-significant-digit-first answer serialization improves mean arithmetic+code_trace IID semantic exact accuracy by at least 5 percentage points over conventional most-significant-digit-first serialization, with positive direction in at least 2 of 3 paired seeds.
hypotheses.H16b: Least-significant-digit-first serialization improves carry/borrow-heavy arithmetic IID semantic exact by at least 5 percentage points and does not reduce mean memory_update IID semantic exact by more than 2 percentage points.
hypotheses.H16c: Least-significant-digit-first serialization does not reduce the sum of surface-transfer and extrapolation semantic exact accuracy by more than 2 percentage points and does not reduce counterfactual both-correct-pair rate by more than 2 percentage points.

data.chronology: memory write order preserved; query changes create counterfactual pairs

training.optimizer: AdamW lr 0.001 warmup30 cosine-to15%, betas(0.9,0.95), weight_decay0.01, grad_clip1
training.objective: answer-only masked CE over full byte259 vocabulary
training.selection: fixed step600 endpoints only; validation and held never select checkpoints or hyperparameters

serialization.lsd_first: MODE:L prompt plus F=<same sign prefix if negative, decimal digits reversed>; target prefix length is identical to control
serialization.scoring_parser: deterministic external parser only; parser has no access to case/gold and performs only syntax validation plus digit reversal for lsd_first

success_rule: H16a is primary; H16b/H16c are required guardrails for calling the mechanism confirmed. This cannot establish Qwen parity or general intelligence.
scope: small paired output-serialization mechanism screen; not 300-800M, not a Qwen comparison, not a claim of broad reasoning superiority
